name: Vertical Nursing Badge Reference Cards (30 Cards)
seoTitle: Vertical Nursing Badge Reference Cards Set
metaDescription: A set of 30 vertical badge reference cards covering topics like lab values, EKG, and vitals. A practical gift for nursing students and new grad nurses.
summary: Thirty vertical reference cards that clip behind a badge, covering topics like lab values, EKG basics, and vitals for quick review.
whyItWorks: Nursing students and new grads spend a lot of mental energy trying to remember normal ranges and basics while also managing patients, charting, and nerves. Badge reference cards give them a quick place to glance for reminders, and the vertical format is designed to hang behind an ID badge, so they stay with the nurse all shift without taking up a scrubs pocket. The title lists lab values, EKG, and vitals among the topics, which are things students review constantly during clinicals.

A set of 30 cards gives them room to pick the ones they actually need and leave the rest at home. That makes it a smart gift for someone starting nursing school, heading into a first clinical rotation, or beginning orientation as a new grad. Nurses switching to a new specialty can also find a refresher handy. The bonus cheat sheets mentioned in the title are a nice extra for studying. It is a practical gift that shows you understand what the first year of nursing actually feels like.
goodToKnow: Reference cards are study and memory aids, so the recipient should always follow their facility's policies and current references.
Check the listing for the full list of card topics to make sure it matches their program or specialty.
Pair with a sturdy badge reel so the cards have something to hang from.

faq.q: Can a nursing student use this?
faq.a: Yes, students are the main audience. The cards are handy for clinicals and reviewing between classes.

faq.q: Is this useful for an experienced nurse?
faq.a: An experienced nurse may not need most cards, but someone changing specialties or precepting students might still appreciate a set.
